response.sql:
WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(CAST(sm.facetresmm AS REAL) / sm.geomdeltamm) AS ratio
  FROM sites s
  JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.geomdeltamm != 0
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT
    insurstat,
    AVG(ratio) AS status_avg
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT
    sr.insurstat,
    sr.ratio,
    ss.status_avg
  FROM site_ratios sr
  JOIN status_stats ss ON sr.insurstat = ss.insurstat
  WHERE sr.ratio > ss.status_avg
)
SELECT
  insurstat,
  AVG(ratio) AS above_avg_sites_ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS above_avg_site_count,
  AVG(ratio) - AVG(status_avg) AS excess_over_status_avg
FROM above_avg
GROUP BY insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing ratios" means excluding mesh records where facetresmm or geomdeltamm is NULL, or where geomdeltamm equals 0 (to avoid undefined division). Each site's ratio is the arithmetic mean of its valid mesh record ratios.
Sites appearing in the result have at least one mesh record with valid ratio data and a non-NULL insurstat value.
